title: General Acute Emergency & First Response
source_citation: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) International First Aid Guidelines 2020

steps.text_key: Call 112 immediately if the patient's condition is worsening, unclear, or causing severe distress
Ensure the immediate area is safe for yourself and the patient before approaching
Assess responsiveness: ask clear questions and check that the person is breathing comfortably
Place the person in a comfortable resting position: sitting up if breathing is difficult, or lying down with head supported if feeling faint
Keep the patient calm, comfortable, and protected from temperature extremes (shade if overheated, blanket if cold)
Monitor breathing and responsiveness continuously; if they become unresponsive, begin chest compressions immediately

do_not: Do not leave the person alone if their condition is deteriorating
Do not give any unknown medications, food, or alcoholic drinks
Do not force an injured or distressed person to stand or walk
